thread:
Maya: kicking off a canary for model v3 today. plan is percent-based ramp + region gating. will flip feature flag and monitor latency/err rates.

Ajit: +1. which flag name are we using? and what's the initial pct/regions?

Maya: using `rollout/canary_model_v3`. start at 2% global in us-west-2 only, then 10% after 30m if SLI checks pass, then 25% for other US regions. no EU/APAC until manual approval.

Samir: putting the canary policy in Console now. quick checklist: prewarm KV cache, ensure quantized variant available for fallback, and confirm model card + safety filters.

Maya: good call. prewarm done, quantized fallback pinned to `model-v3-q4`. safety filters same as prod.

Leo: what are the abort conditions in case of regressions? put them in the toggle notes so oncall sees them.

Maya: abort conditions: 1) 10% increase in 95th latency vs baseline OR 2) error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR 3) Quality regression flagged by eval hook. If any trigger, toggle back to `model-v2` and notify #incidents + oncall.

Ajit: can we add automated metric checks to the rollout? i can wire the metric thresholds into the rollout config. example snippet:```json
{
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 2, "regions": ["us-west-2"], "duration_min": 30},
    {"pct": 10, "regions": ["us-west-2", "us-east-1"], "duration_min": 60}
  ],
  "abort_on": {"latency_p95_delta_pct": 10, "error_rate_pct": 0.5}
}
```

Samir: looks good. also add a health-check hook for KV cache miss rate and tokenization failures. those spiky errors caused trouble last time.

Maya: added KV miss threshold: abort if miss rate > 3% sustained 5m. tokenization failures logged and alert at >0.1%

deploy-bot: deploy started for `rollout/canary_model_v3` @1771248002 :rocket:

Leo: reminder to tag the canary with `owner:eng-ml` and `runbook:/docs/runbooks/model-canary.md` so support knows where to look.

Maya: tags added, runbook link in the toggle notes. monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/model-v3-canary (metrics: latency_p95, error_rate, kv_miss, eval_quality).

Ajit: pinging SRE to make sure autoscale is set for the new variant. @Samir can you confirm?

Samir: confirmed autoscale policy applied, min replicas = 2 for canary nodes.

Leo: if anything abnormal pop up, use the emergency rollback button in Console and @mention oncall. :thumbsup:

Maya: will monitor first 30m then update. posting periodic status here.

Maya: 30m update: stage 1 at 2% in us-west-2 completed, metrics within thresholds (latency +2.1% p95, error_rate 0.12%, kv_miss 0.8%). proceeding to 10% for US regions.

Ajit: good. logging rollout timestamps and metric deltas to the release notes.

deploy-bot: stage 2 ramp to 10% started @1771248305

Maya: will check again at +60m and follow up.
